scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis minio mosquitto migrate minio-init
scripts.db:verify-indexes: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f - < infra/verify/spatial-index.sql
scripts.db:verify-search: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f - < infra/verify/search-index.sql
scripts.data:boundary: docker compose run --rm gdal sh tools/data/extract-district-boundary.sh
